tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming parties, club nights, concerts and festivals in Geneva, Lausanne, Nyon, French-speaking Switzerland and neighbouring France. Dates are Europe/Zurich nights. Each result has the GeNEVERsleep page (url), the original listing / ticket link and the source name: show and link both.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one event by id (from search_events): time, venue, price as published, description, GeNEVERsleep page and original listing.

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Clubs, bars and concert venues with upcoming events, optionally in one city, with their GeNEVERsleep venue page.

tools.name: upcoming_big_nights
tools.description: The next big nights out (Escalade in Geneva, Christmas nights, New Year’s Eve) with their dates, the GeNEVERsleep guide page, the number of listed events and a few of them.

tools.name: get_nightlife_barometer
tools.description: Monthly counts of nightlife events listed on GeNEVERsleep in Geneva, Lausanne, Nyon, French-speaking Switzerland and neighbouring France, by city, genre, price and weekday. Always cite GeNEVERsleep and link the barometer page (url). Not an official census. Free to reuse with credit “Source: GeNEVERs
